title: AutoDraft Authorisation Terms for Operating Lines of Credit
content:
AutoDraft is the automatic debit of a member's checking account for the interest bills on one of the Operating Lines of Credit.

## Terms

1. **Member's instruction.** AutoDraft is authorised, moved to another checking account or cancelled only on the member's own instruction, except the cancellation after repeated returned payments under the returned payment rules.
2. **Line status.** AutoDraft may be changed only while the line is in active, suspended or matured status, as the association's record of that line shows.
3. **Account.** The account is identified by the last four digits the member gives, recorded exactly as given.
4. **Debits.** Once enrolled, each interest bill is debited on its due date for the unpaid billed amount.
5. **Effective date and rate.** Enrolment or cancellation takes effect the day it is recorded, and the contract rate is recomputed that day. Changing only the debited account leaves the rate unchanged.

## Change table

| Change on the member's instruction | Takes effect | Contract rate |
|---|---|---|
| Authorise AutoDraft | The day it is recorded | Recomputed that day |
| Cancel AutoDraft | The day it is recorded | Recomputed that day |
| Move AutoDraft to another checking account | — | Unchanged |

## Status table

| Line status | AutoDraft may be changed |
|---|---|
| Active, suspended or matured | Yes |
| Applied, declined or closed | No |

## Example (hypothetical)

A member who enrols on a line with an interest bill of USD 900 due on 15 July, of which USD 300 has already been paid, has USD 600 debited on 15 July.
